text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Meeting with Greek Foreign Minister Theodoros Pangalos in Skopje was the basis for the development of bilateral defense and police relations, Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski said.

- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski to visit Tirana soon. Possible meeting between Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski and Albanian Prime Minister Baskim Fino in Ohrid, according to paper's unofficial sources.
- Macedonia and the Netherlands signed a road transportation agreement in Skopje on Tuesday.
- Greek composer Mikis Theodorakis will conduct Zorba the Greek at the Ohrid International Music Festival this summer. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201-196
